visual_brief.subject: Images 2.6 separates visual quality from planning effort
verified_context: OpenAI released Images 2.6 with GIF generation, image markup, SVG export and separate image-quality and complexity controls.
The controls expose distinct speed, fidelity and planning choices.
Performance and edit-consistency claims are vendor-reported.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A production workflow can route one visual task through different effort and fidelity paths.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A blank stone image tile enters a sculptural fork with a short terracotta edit route and a longer articulated dark-metal planning route.

candidate_notes.A: Selected: one blank input splits cleanly into a short terracotta path and a longer articulated dark-metal path before converging on one blank output. The dual-effort choice remains legible in every crop.
candidate_notes.B: The two routes and pivots are visible, but the diagonal input blocks and uneven endpoints make the workflow harder to parse at a glance.
candidate_notes.C: The loop is balanced and crop-safe, but the segmented terracotta path blurs the intended contrast between a short direct route and a longer articulated planning route.

crop_review.article_desktop: The 21:9 center crop retains the blank input, both contrasting routes and shared output.
crop_review.article_mobile: The full fork-and-converge relationship remains visible in 16:9.
crop_review.square: The center square prioritizes the direct terracotta arc and articulated dark route while retaining both endpoints.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320px wide, the smooth warm route and jointed dark route remain distinct.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared all candidates above the declared references for sculptural route logic, matte pale-stone forms, restrained terracotta/charcoal contrast and minimal silhouettes. A is the cleanest translation of separate effort paths and most closely matches the references' visual economy.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Codex model self-review of three full-size candidates, two declared golden references, a reference-first comparison sheet, and desktop/mobile/square/thumbnail crops. The canonical Playwright renderer could not launch because Chromium was unavailable, so ImageMagick produced the equivalent inspected sheet; repository validation remains authoritative.

A.prompt: Wide sculptural fork: one blank stone image tile enters a short smooth terracotta route and a longer articulated dark-metal route that converge on one blank output; no text or interface elements.

B.prompt: Wide tactile visual workflow with one blank tile, a direct terracotta path and a longer jointed dark-metal planning path reaching a shared blank output; no prohibited elements.

C.prompt: Wide minimal loop connecting one blank input to one blank output through a smooth terracotta upper route and articulated dark-metal lower route; restrained editorial materiality and no prohibited elements.
